{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
# The data uses thousands separators, so we need to strip commas
# and convert to float
# Check if any revenue values contain commas
if data['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).any():
    data['revenue'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
    data['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(data['revenue'], errors='coerce')
else:
    data['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(data['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Verify that revenue is now numeric
print("Revenue dtype after cleaning:", data['revenue'].dtype)

# Check for any invalid revenue values
print("Number of invalid revenue values:", data['revenue'].isna().sum())

# Check for QA orders with revenue 999999.99
qa_orders = data[data['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print("QA orders found:", len(qa_orders))

# Drop QA orders
if len(qa_orders) > 0:
    data = data[data['revenue'] != 999999.99]
    print(f"Dropped {len(qa_orders)} QA orders.")

# Drop refunded orders
refunded_orders = data[data['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Dropped {len(refunded_orders)} refunded orders.")
data = data[data['status'] != 'refunded']

# Check for remaining data
print("After cleaning, data shape:", data.shape)

# Now filter for loyal customers only
loyal_data = data[data['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']
print(f"Number of loyal customer orders: {len(loyal_data)}")

# Compute conversion rate
converted_count = loyal_data['converted'].sum()
total_count = len(loyal_data)
conversion_rate = converted_count / total_count

print(f"Converted: {converted_count}")
print(f"Total: {total_count}")
print(f"Conversion rate: {conversion_rate}")"}
